note: Walk-forward backtest over 365 days: each day the models were refit on earlier data only and the daily evolution ran as in production, then the full online system (trust weights, ranges, calibration, the shown price's shrinkage) was stepped minute by minute. The direction model's settings were chosen on Bitcast's coin (Bitcoin), not on these days; the days after 24 May 2026 were looked at during the September 2026 review. The untouched test is the year before (docs/EXPERIMENTS.md) and, from now on, the live record. Every forecast is in data/backtest/.
